base_training.selection: fixed_epoch_12; inner validation is diagnostic only
base_training.calibration_role: excluded from base and topology fitting

promotion_rule.primary: Topology versus baseline paired-bootstrap MCC point delta >= 0.005 and 95% lower confidence bound > 0.
promotion_rule.non_degradation: Topology versus baseline balanced-accuracy and AUPRC lower confidence bounds each >= -0.005; Brier upper confidence bound <= 0.002.
promotion_rule.mechanism_control: Topology must exceed both local and matching controls on at least one primary discrimination metric without a worse Cys>=4 label-standardized error point estimate.
promotion_rule.decision: If any condition fails, retain a negative feasibility result; do not change threshold, seeds, epochs, candidate count, distance limit or regularization after examining OOF.
